DHR is −2.98% on StockAnalysis but −3.42% on Yahoo; StockAnalysis (primary) is below the 3% threshold, so DHR is excluded. A Yahoo-listed headline said Danaher shares rose pre-market on its Q3 beat; that is likely from earlier in the session.

drivers: The AI trade is bouncing: Nasdaq-100 futures +0.7% and S&P 500 futures +0.3% after SpaceX's first public-company quarter beat (revenue $14.6B vs $12.7B expected, about half from its AI unit) and Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to study a merger (SpaceX +8.3%, Tesla +1.3%). Super Micro raised its preliminary fiscal Q1 revenue to $18.5–19.5B from $14.5–15.5B (+12.5%), lifting Dell, HPE, Amkor and the chip group after the Philadelphia semiconductor index's eight-session losing streak (SOXX +1.6% pre-market). Netflix (−6.8%) guided Q4 below estimates and cut its ad-revenue outlook; Intuitive Surgical (−6.6%) beat but disclosed a $450M legal charge; AT&T (−5.0%) beat and raised guidance but telecoms are weak on SpaceX competition worries. Elsewhere, Capital One, Elevance and Lithia beat, while Abbott (nutrition spinoff), Danaher, Moody's and Philip Morris slipped after results. The 10-year yield is ~5.09% and VIX ~17.2; oil is elevated (Brent ~$108–111) after Houthi attacks claimed on Aramco sites. Europe and Japan are higher (DAX +1.0%, Nikkei +0.9%) while the Hang Seng fell 0.9%. Tesla, Meta, IBM, Texas Instruments, Lam Research and SAP report after the close.
